items.title: Willie "Old Man" Parker Interview, 1958-11-07
items.q: Professor Shalom gave us that. And a friend that brought music.

ctx.x: And did you have music for that?
We had music for Sing On, Glory of the Lamb, and When the Saints. There you go. What a prayer we have in Jesus. Professor Shalom gave us that. And a friend that brought music.
Did you play any dance tunes in the brass band? Uh, dances? Yes.
